hero.lede: CHRON.OS is a local-first archival intelligence system for preserving documents, media, provenance, temporal context, and user-weighted meaning — without making the cloud the source of truth.

console.releaseBody: Portable ZIP remains available for no-install testing.

pipeline.label: Source
pipeline.description: Original path and intake context remain visible.

pipeline.label: Hash
pipeline.description: Every artifact gets a cryptographic anchor.

pipeline.label: Metadata
pipeline.description: Sidecar facts stay local and inspectable.

pipeline.label: Meaning
pipeline.description: User-weighted context can evolve over time.

capabilities.title: Archive
capabilities.copy: Preserve originals, metadata, hashes, and paths.

capabilities.title: Understand
capabilities.copy: Classify by domain, form, role, and salience.

capabilities.title: Navigate
capabilities.copy: Move by timeline, ontology, duplicate, or relation.

panels.label: User Knowledge Well

panels.copy: Significance, score, role, and horizon can be attached to an artifact.

panels.copy: Local user-weighted context wins over inferred meaning.

panels.label: Trace relations
panels.copy: Every related artifact, every shared domain, every chain of inheritance — kept and walkable.

panels.label: Cross-form trails

panels.label: No data is orphaned
panels.copy: If it entered the archive, the path back is preserved.

panels.copy: Ask Archivist to find files, explain structure, create folders, or review the ontology.

panels.copy: Home · Downloads · Documents · Current root. Pin any drive.

release.recommendation: Recommended for most Windows users: one-click installer. Portable ZIP is for no-install testing or users who already have the required runtime pieces.

footer.description: CHRON.OS — local-first archival intelligence. A Hyperion Industries system.
